_comment: Per-background placement of the 'x月x日' date text on each sign. Copy to backgrounds.json and edit — or manage it entirely from QQ (bot admin, private chat): dateimg.addbg <name> +image, dateimg.setcfg <name> <field> <value>, dateimg.delbg <name>, dateimg.mode <gif|png>. This file is re-read from disk on every render (no reload command). Coordinates are pixels on the ORIGINAL background PNG; (x,y) is the CENTER of the rendered date text. The final image is downscaled to output_max_px before sending.

_field_help.default_font: font filename in resource/dateimg/fonts/ used when a background's 'font' is empty; if also empty, the first font found there is used
_field_help.mode: output format: 'gif' = single-frame GIF (QQ shows it as a meme/sticker, transparent bg) or 'png' = normal image. Switch from chat with dateimg.mode <gif|png>.
_field_help.lunar: global on/off (default true): draw the lunar day-of-month above the date in smaller red 大写 numerals (捌/拾捌/廿捌).
_field_help.layout: per-background: 'single' (rectangle signs, one line 'x月x日') or 'double' (square/circle signs, two lines 'x月' / 'x日'). The date is always centered, so it fits any length.
_field_help.rotation: degrees clockwise to tilt the text so it lies flat on the sign (e.g. -7.0)
_field_help.color: text color, any ImageMagick color name or #RRGGBB (default black)
_field_help.font: font filename in resource/dateimg/fonts/ for THIS background; empty = use default_font
